summary: The WCBEditAll user control facilitates the editing of Enrollment-related data within a grid interface. It handles parameters like CohortID, TermID, CourseID, and provides functionalities for filtering by various statuses. The control includes workflow steps for saving, editing, and updating safety and waiver statuses for students.
purpose: Manage and edit enrollment details, specifically focusing on Worker's Compensation Board (WCB) statuses and safety requirements.

workflows.name: Edit Enrollment Details
steps: Initialize parameters for the grid view.
Bind data to the grid and manage visibility of controls based on Enrollment ID.
Handle row commands for saving and editing.
Redirect after processing safety and WCB updates.

business_rules: Hide Save All button if EnrollmentID is not zero.
Show Save panel if EnrollmentID is zero.
validations: Ensure UserSession is active before selecting data.
calculations: Convert DropDownList value to integer for StudentPrerequisites update.
Toggle visibility of panels based on row count and read-only state.
conditions: EnrollmentID determines visibility and editability of grid rows.
system_behavior: Adjust sorting behavior of grid based on user input.
Disable editing fields if session is read-only.
exceptions: Cancel selection process if UserSession is null.
